tail_rule: k=floor(n*p) independently per recording and side; trim k at each end or replace by boundary order statistics; k=0 means mean
selection: 36 CNN/STT method pairs, lowest inner person-equal MAE of frozen mean-difference ensemble; ties use listed method order
fixed_comparisons: same aggregation on CNN and STT for all six predefined methods
calibration: OLS slope and intercept refitted using only each base model training recordings, same unweighted recording/side OLS as original
ensemble: Keep previous fold-specific CNN weights and bilateral-difference fractions; do not refit them
control_diagnostic: Five window_control outer refits; fixed six aggregators, training-only calibration; no outer-based selection
limitations: Repeatedly inspected development cohort, not independent final confirmation
Inner terminal checkpoints and outer selected-epoch checkpoints have different training lengths
Existing blend weights and new aggregation use the same inner validation people; outer people excluded
No probability classifier trained in this comparison
